name: Red Skull
summary: The Red Skull is Captain America’s enemy. A predecessor using the name appears in Captain America Comics #1, and Johann Shmidt becomes the enduring version. He is not a Spider-Man villain. This record exists so the archive does not file him in the rogues’ gallery by mistake.
relation: Primarily a Captain America villain. No core Spider-Man role is claimed here.
firstAppearance: Captain America Comics #1 (1941) introduces a Red Skull. Johann Shmidt is the version that endures, created in that early run.
powers: A strategist and combatant. Specific enhancements change by story and are not one fixed Spider-Man power set.
origin: A Nazi antagonist built as Captain America’s opposite.
